notes.title: Marabundle at gamescom latam!
notes.notes:
[b]Marabundle at Gamescom latam![/b]

Gamescom latam started today, June 26, and Marabundle will be there with the game Super Bafo Champsionship, from Clops game studio, along with our friends from Astral Game Studio, with their new game Scarlet Manor: the Heir, both at Panorama Brasil! Stop by and have a chat with the devs!

notes.title: MARABUNDLE REVEAL: DOGFIGHTS IN SLZ
notes.notes:
Introducing firsthand the game DOGFIGHTS IN SLZ, a frantic gravity shoot 'em up arcade based on Luftrausers. Defend the skies of the city of Sâo Luís do Maranhão from an alien attack!

Developed by Wired Dreams Studio, DOGFIGHTS IN SLZ is one of the games that make up MARABUNDLE, a package of minigames gathered under a single theme: Maranhão, our home region! Follow us, add to your wishlist, and keep an eye out for more gameplay of the other games coming soon!
